title: Veyra Code Guard team settings
description: Settings for Veyra Code Guard, shared by VS Code, the command line, the pre-commit guard and the GitHub Action.

failOn.description: Fail the pre-commit guard, the command line and the GitHub check at this severity or above.

ignorePaths.description: Paths to skip, such as "docs/**" or "*.min.js".

disabledRules.description: Rule ids to turn off, such as "raw-ip-url". Run "Veyra Code Guard: What It Looks For" to see them all.

customRules.description: Your team's own patterns, checked on every line of every matching file, in any language.

id.description: A short id, used in veyra-guard-ignore comments.

pattern.description: A regular expression (JavaScript syntax) matched against each line.

title.description: A short name for the finding.

files.description: Only check files matching these globs, such as "src/**" or "*.php".
